risk: Onsite paid dining or food facility lacks a viable RR-5 approval path
primary_control: Exclude home occupation and obtain written classification before investment
trigger_or_evidence: Agency response identifying an available entitlement

risk: Proposed temporary model is not a qualifying special event
primary_control: Present alternatives and obtain written classification

risk: Domestic well cannot legally or reliably serve food use
primary_control: Water-source review testing and capacity study

risk: Residential OWTS cannot accept commercial flow or grease
primary_control: Measure pilot flow and obtain OWTS/grease determination

risk: Solid-fuel smoker clearance or suppression cost is prohibitive
Demand is limited to eight faire weekends
Specialized improvement contributes little resale value
primary_control: Adaptive design and appraiser plan review

risk: Smoke traffic light or noise creates complaints
primary_control: Site screening small reservation count and operating limits
Approved process logs training and stop-service authority

risk: Undeclared allergen or cross-contact harms guest
primary_control: Allergen matrix reservation disclosures and dedicated controls

risk: Wind cold heat or wildfire restriction disrupts service
primary_control: Published cancellation policy and objective go/no-go check

risk: Small team cannot safely execute service
primary_control: Timed rehearsals role clarity and minimum staffing
Early written feasibility and competitive quotes

risk: Commercial use changes financing insurance or tax treatment
primary_control: Preconstruction lender insurer and assessor review

risk: Membership structure is treated as a renamed restaurant or event business
primary_control: Use a bona fide club only if it has independent purpose governance and programs and obtain written zoning classification
trigger_or_evidence: Issued Zoning Verification Letter addressing the complete club facts

risk: Public Health determines recurring club suppers do not qualify for the nonprofit event exclusion
primary_control: Request written interpretation before formation equipment or food sales
trigger_or_evidence: Written Public Health response identifying the applicable food pathway

risk: Club funds or improvements improperly benefit the property owner
primary_control: Independent legal and tax review plus disinterested approval and fair market property agreement
trigger_or_evidence: Written counsel opinion conflict record and executed agreement
